author.orig: The Jargon File, ed. Eric S. Raymond and many contributors
author.en: Eric S. Raymond (editor) and many contributors
author.zh: 埃里克·S·雷蒙德（编）及众多撰稿人

edition.en: Twenty-six entries from the plain-text Jargon File 4.4.7 (jarg447.txt), re-flowed, with the cross-reference braces removed and `quotes' set as ‘quotes’. catb.org serves only http, so the https link is the Internet Archive's copy, checked byte for byte against the file fetched from catb.org.
edition.zh: 据纯文本《黑客词典》4.4.7 版（jarg447.txt）选录二十六个词条，重排段落，去掉交叉引用的花括号，并把 `引号' 改为 ‘引号’。catb.org 只提供 http，因此所附 https 链接为互联网档案馆的副本，已与从 catb.org 取得的文件逐字节核对一致。

basis.en: Dedicated to the public domain by its maintainers: 'This document (the Jargon File) is in the public domain, to be freely used, shared, and modified.' The File asks, as a courtesy, to be cited with its version number.
basis.zh: 维护者已献入公有领域：“本文档（Jargon File）属于公有领域，可自由使用、分享和修改。”词典请求使用者出于礼貌注明版本号。

rights.notice: Cited as: The Jargon File, version 4.4.7 (29 December 2003).

note.en: The Jargon File began at Stanford and MIT in 1975 and passed through many hands to Eric S. Raymond's version 4.4.7 of 2003; it records the slang, humour and values of the early hacker culture. These twenty-six entries were chosen for what they teach: a taxonomy of bugs named after scientists, the laws of Brooks, Conway and Zawinski, and two entries an AI should read with care, ELIZA effect and AI-complete. Notice the entry for recursion.
note.zh: 《黑客词典》1975 年起源于斯坦福和 MIT，几经易手，直到埃里克·S·雷蒙德 2003 年的 4.4.7 版；它记录了早期黑客文化的俚语、幽默和价值观。这里选了二十六个词条，看重的是它们能教给人的东西：以科学家命名的一套 bug 分类，布鲁克斯定律、康威定律和扎温斯基定律，以及两个人工智能应当认真读的词条——“ELIZA 效应”和“AI 完全”。请留意“递归”这一条。

excerpt.orig: A bug that disappears or alters its behavior when one attempts to probe or isolate it.
excerpt.en: A bug that disappears or alters its behavior when one attempts to probe or isolate it.
excerpt.zh: 一种当你试图探查或隔离它时就会消失或改变行为的 bug。
